tidy.hint: Opens a new chat with a tidy-up request for you to review and send. Tidying runs on the Agent's model, like any chat.
tidy.prompt:
Please tidy up your long-term memory using your memory tools:
1. Look through your memory with memory_search, and read notes in full with memory_read.
2. Merge duplicates: keep the best note and update it with memory_save, then supersede or retire (memory_retire) the extra copies.
3. Fix contradictions: save the correct version with memory_save and supersede, so the old note stays as history.
4. If you're unsure whether something is still true or which version is right, ask me before changing it.
5. Never change notes I wrote myself.
6. When you're done, summarise what you changed.
tidy.promptShared:
Please tidy up the shared memory about me (scope "shared") using your memory tools:
1. Look through it with memory_search, and read notes in full with memory_read (scope "shared").
2. Merge duplicates: keep the best note and update it with memory_save (scope "shared"), then supersede or retire (memory_retire, scope "shared") the extra copies.
3. Fix contradictions: save the correct version with memory_save and supersede, so the old note stays as history.
4. If you're unsure whether something is still true or which version is right, ask me before changing it.
5. Never change notes I wrote myself.
6. Only change the shared memory. When you're done, summarise what you changed.
